title: Potential out-of-bounds in `removeCardBundlesFromPacketPool`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `removeCardBundlesFromPacketPool` function in the `CardAllocationPool` contract has a critical flaw that could lead to `out-of-bounds` access errors.  When removing card bundles, the function **swaps the selected bundle with the last unselected bundle and then pops the last element from the array.**  ```solidity             // Swap selected card bundle with last unselected card bundle and pop             cardBundles[index] = cardBundles[cardBundles.length - 1];             cardBundles.pop(); ```  However,
